EHR-DS-QA: A Synthetic QA Dataset Derived from Medical Discharge Summaries

output.population: 21466 medical discharge summaries extracted from the MIMIC-IV-Note dataset
output.summary: Synthetic question-and-answer pairs generated with a Llama 2 model from medical discharge summaries in MIMIC-IV-Note, a subset verified by a physician, for training clinical retrieval-augmented question-answering models. Generation code accompanies the data.
